//: NEON_MDF_PATH corresponds to ESP-IDF IDF_PATH. VS Code launched from Dock/Spotlight may not inherit the shell environment. Set the path here so CMake Tools and the integrated terminal can find the SDK without sourcing neon-mdf/export.sh. The default relative path goes from examples/<X>/ up two levels to the repository root and then into neon-mdf/. Update it when moving the app.
